headline: Open computational tools for reproducible omics and chromatin sequencing analysis
label: Computational Tools For Omics Visualization
summary: Recent preprints and a published package release tools for reproducible visualization and pipeline-based analysis of omics and chromatin sequencing data.
synthesis: The dominant thread is infrastructure for making omics and sequencing analysis reproducible and accessible. CREPAS provides a Nextflow pipeline for nascent and parental chromatin sequencing data spanning ChOR-seq, SCAR-seq, and OK-seq, and is the only item directly addressing regulatory epigenomics. The remaining items center on visualization. Killiverse offers a no-code cloud resource aggregating killifish bulk, single-cell, proteomic, and lipidomic datasets with ortholog mapping. EnrichViz provides code-free interactive visualization of pathway enrichment results from omics data. Bamsnap-LRS automates batch visualization of long-read sequencing alignments with phased SNP inspection. SCpubr generates publication-ready single-cell transcriptome visualizations built on Seurat. What is new is the packaging of these steps as reusable, interactive, or automated tools that lower the barrier to standardized analysis and figure generation.
